name: Nadia Soheilizadeh
text: I had such a great experience with Candice, my hairdresser! I’m really happy with both my haircut and colour. She is so patient, friendly, and really takes the time to understand exactly what you want and delivers it perfectly. I always feel comfortable and well taken care of in her chair. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for amazing results and a lovely experience!

name: Carika Jacobs
text: I had such a great experience with Candice! She did my cut and colour exactly the way I asked, and I absolutely love the result. She really listened to what I wanted and made me feel so comfortable throughout the whole process. My hair looks and feels amazing—couldn’t be happier. Highly recommend her! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

name: Richa pranks
text: It was really great pleasure for Candice to do my hair with so much care and also advising the right care. Candice is so professional and has great customer care. I have not gone anywhere else for my hair since I have been with her. She is qualified and knows her job well. The best part is her massage, it makes you so relaxed at the end of service. Keep up the great work Candice.

name: Edwin Freeman
text: Such an amazing hairdresser. So professional with heaps of experience

name: Janice Freeman
text: Wonderful young talented hairdresser who knows just how to do a nice short cut with volume in my very straight hair. Thank you Candice
